name: Fredun Pharmaceuticals Limited
summary: Fredun Pharmaceuticals Ltd. specializes in the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of a diverse range of products, including pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, and various herbal and dietary supplements for human consumption, alongside its animal healthcare portfolio. Nariman Bamansha Medhora established the company on June 8, 1987, and its main operations are conducted from Mumbai, India.
